{{Conjecture|legends}}
{{Quote|The Nine Ruling Families are like any other families. Blood and merit create siblings and cousins and ranking distants. Some are released, others are rematched, others are born to trial. The same as any other family.|Aide Chaf'ees'aklaio, to Dean Jinzler|<ref name="Survivor's Quest">''[[Survivor's Quest]]''</ref>}}
'''Rematching''' was a process by which [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] individuals belonging to one [[Chiss family/Legends|Chiss family]] transferred to another family. In some cases, an individual could be '''released''' to their original family. The [[Ruling Families/Legends|Ruling Families]] selected [[Merit adoptive/Legends|merit adoptives]] in a manner analogously to how the [[Defense Hierarchy]] selected [[Senior officer/Legends|senior]] [[Chiss officer/Legends|officers]] to join their ranks. Every [[Chiss warrior/Legends|Chiss warrior]] adopted a probationary rank of merit adoptive that would be lost at the end of one's [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force|military]] service if that person did not gain the rank of [[Trial-born/Legends|Trial-born]] first<ref name="Outbound Flight">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref> by being "born to trial."<ref name="Survivor's Quest" /> The Trial-born were given the opportunity of being permanently matched to the Family. In some cases, a Trial-born could be granted the rank of a [[Ranking distant/Legends|ranking distant]]. Trial-borns could have a hearing at a family stronghold to renounce their family rank.<ref name="Outbound Flight" />

==History==
{{Quote|Thrawn, you can't continue to push the lines this way. Peaceful watchfulness is the Chiss way, and the Nine Ruling Families won't stand by forever while you ignore basic military doctrine. More to the point, the Eighth Family has made it clear that they'll release you before they permit your actions to damage their standing.''"<br />"''We were both born as commoners. I can live that way again if I have to. But I'll do what I can to assure that the Eighth Family doesn't release or rematch you on my account.''"<br />"''I'm not worried about my own position. I'm trying to keep my brother from throwing away a fine and honorable career for nothing.|Thrass and Thrawn|<ref name="Outbound Flight" />}}
[[File:Outboundthrawn.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Force Commander Mitth'raw'nuruodo (pictured) has repeatedly threatened his status as a Trial-born within the Eighth Ruling Family.]]
Following the [[Battle of Geroon]], [[Syndic/Legends|Syndic]] [[Mitth'ras'safis/Legends|Mitth'ras'safis]], [[Core name/Legends|core name]] "Thrass," of the Eighth Ruling Family warned his brother, [[Force Commander]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]], core name "Thrawn," of the [[Chiss Expansionary Fleet/Legends|Chiss Expansionary Fleet]] that the Eighth Family would release him to his [[Mitth'ras'safis's blood family|original family]] before his actions could damage their standing within the Ruling Families. Ignoring Thrass' warning, Thrawn reminded him that they were both [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] as commoners and that he could live that way again. He promised his brother that he would do what he could so his actions wouldn't damage Thrass' position within the Eighth Ruling Family.<ref name="Outbound Flight" />

In the aftermath of the [[Battle for Outbound Flight|battle]] for the [[Colony ship/Legends|colony ship]] ''[[Outbound Flight]]'', Thrawn was escorted to<ref name="Outbound Flight" /> the [[Chaf family/Legends|Fifth Ruling Family]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]]<ref name="CSWE Chaf Exalted">{{CSWECite|I|117|''Chaf Exalted''}}</ref> ''[[Chaf Exalted]]''. Aboard the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] conference room, [[Aristocra/Legends|Aristocra]] [[Chaf'orm'bintrano]], core name "Formbi," of the Fifth Ruling Family threatened to revoke Thrawn's family rank in the Eighth Family. Thrawn knew that the Eighth Ruling Family would insist on a hearing at an Eighth Family stronghold and believed that the alien technology that he captured would keep him in the Family. Formbi believed that Thrawn meant the ''Outbound Flight'', but in fact, Thrawn referred to the [[Vagaari/Legends|Vagaari]] [[Gravity well projector/Legends|gravity well projector]], on which Thrawn corrected him.<ref name="Outbound Flight" />

In [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]],<ref name="Survivor's Quest Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Survivor's Quest]]'' to [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]].</ref> [[Aide/Legends|Aide]] [[Chaf'ees'aklaio]], core name "Feesa," of the Fifth Ruling Family explained to [[Dean Jinzler]] how Chiss families were set up. Feesa described how the individuals could be rematched or released from their family.<ref name="Survivor's Quest" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rematching was first mentioned in the [[2004]] novel ''[[Survivor's Quest]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="Survivor's Quest" />
